description: Governor's Office-North Western Province - Notification made by the Hon Governor in the North Western Province
categorisation: This gazette notification concerns the extension of an investigation period for a commission looking into potential offenses committed by a Mayor. The content involves a judicial officer (retired) conducting the investigation under the Municipal Councils Ordinance. This falls squarely within judicial/law enforcement matters, specifically covering legal proceedings, investigations, and the application of ordinances related to local government officials.
